mutant.description: THREE planted mutants, each a real source-text mutation written to a disposable sibling file beside the real engine (org/modules/graph/_tmp_trigger_mutant_<kind>_<pid>.py, never a temp dir elsewhere -- comp_trigger.py has no _WORKSPACE depth-sensitivity the way comp-iam does, but the convention is kept for consistency and because _compbudget's own sys.path insert is relative to the real file's directory): (a) scope_dropped -- SCOPE_LINE removed from render()'s output list; (b) crash_reintroduced -- live_rules()'s try/except removed, reverting to the exact pre-fix crash-prone shape; (c) enrich_budget_ignored -- _enrich_matches()'s per-match `remaining <= 0` check disabled.
mutant.expected: (a) render() output on both a hit and a miss loses the scope/delegation text entirely; (b) live_rules() against a client whose list_rules() raises re-raises instead of returning a census_error sentinel; (c) _enrich_matches() under a tiny budget with slow (fixture-delayed) calls completes every match anyway, printing no BUDGET REACHED line and leaving zero matches DEFERRED.
mutant.observed: (a) mutant output carried the scope text on NEITHER hit nor miss -- CT-AC3-MUTANT-SCOPE-LINE-DROPPED-DETECTED PASS. (b) mutant's live_rules() RAISED against the identical _RaisingEvents fake client production correctly swallows -- CT-AC5-MUTANT-CRASH-REINTRODUCED-DETECTED PASS. (c) mutant's _enrich_matches() under the identical tiny-budget/delayed-client scenario printed no BUDGET REACHED and left 0 of 3 matches DEFERRED (vs. >=1 under production) -- CT-AC5-MUTANT-ENRICH-BUDGET-IGNORED-DETECTED PASS. All three mutant files confirmed removed after their runs.
